title: Chapter 718 - 718 First To Kill An Emperor-Level Expert; Lin Yulian'S Dream
content:
Chapter 718 - 718 First To Kill An Emperor-Level Expert; Lin Yulian'S Dream

Chapter 718 - 718 First to Kill an Emperor-Level Expert; Lin Yulian's Dream

718 First to Kill an Emperor-Level Expert; Lin Yulian’s Dream

The master of the Demon Sect felt that he had been tricked miserably. It felt as if he had gotten the hot potato.

When the people from the Demon Sect heard this, they sighed.

If their sect master really had such a powerful curse technique, they would not think much of it even if the Demon Sect was in such a great crisis.

This was because his power would be enough to eliminate all dangers.

…

Earth, Coiling Dragon Villa.

Lin Fan, who was in the middle of his cultivation, suddenly heard a crisp notification in his mind.

[Ding! Your enemy, Zhu Yan, died because of your curse.]

[Ding! Congratulations on being the first to kill an Emperor-level expert. You’ve received the Rainbow Immortal Robe x1, Transcendence Golden Body x1, and Immortal Crystal x1.]

[Rainbow Immortal Robe: Emperor-level equipment. It has a powerful defense that can withstand attacks below the Emperor-level.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up. It was another Emperor-level equipment.

At this moment, there was a knock on the door.

Lin Fan sensed it and knew that it was his daughter, Lin Yulian.

Therefore, he opened his mouth and said, “Come in.”

Lin Yulian walked in.

Lin Yulian had become a graceful beauty.

She had a slender and tall figure and a ruddy face that was somewhat similar to Hu Tian’s. She was very beautiful and cute.

“Yulian, why are you here?” Lin Fan asked dotingly.

“I haven’t seen you in a long time. I miss you.” Lin Yulian giggled.

After saying that, she wrapped her arms around Lin Fan’s neck.

The father-daughter pair chatted for a while, and the atmosphere was very relaxed.

“Dad, I’ve been having a dream recently,” Lin Yulian said.

Lin Fan’s heart skipped a beat, but his expression did not change. He asked, “Oh? What kind of dream?”

“In the dream, it seems like I’m supposed to find something. It seems to be quite important,” Lin Yulian said. “I searched for a long time, but I couldn’t find it.”

At this point, Lin Yulian could not help but frown slightly, as if she was still troubled because she had not found it.

Lin Fan said, “It’s just a dream. Don’t take it to heart.”

“Yes, yes.” Lin Yulian nodded.

After Lin Yulian left, Lin Fan whispered, “System, what’s wrong with Yulian?”

[The answer requires one million spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

“Yes!”

[The trump card left behind by the Immortal Phoenix before it reincarnated can allow it to possess strength that surpasses its previous life and its enemies.]

“What’s the trump card?”

[Unknown.]

Lin Fan could not help but frown. He could only put this matter aside for now.

In the blink of an eye, a year had passed.

On this day, Lin Yulian knocked on Lin Fan’s door once again.

Lin Yulian’s originally rosy face was now slightly pale, and her mental state was extremely poor.

Lin Fan walked in front of Lin Yulian and asked, “Yulian, what’s wrong?”

“Dad, I keep having the same dream about looking for something again. Moreover, I often have difficulty breathing, and my energy is chaotic because I can’t find it…” Lin Yulian said weakly.

As she spoke, her body went limp, and she fell to the ground.

Lin Fan hurriedly stretched out his hand and transferred a large amount of life force.

After a while, Lin Yulian slowly opened her eyes.

“Yulian, are you alright?” Lin Fan asked with concern.

Lin Yulian shook her head.

Then, she looked up at the blue sky and said, “Dad, I think I can feel where the thing I’m looking for is.”

She quietly looked up at the sky, her beautiful eyes filled with yearning.

Lin Fan did not say anything immediately. Instead, he asked the system in his heart.

‘If Yulian doesn’t go and find that thing, will it affect her?’

[The answer requires one million spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

“Yes!”

[If her energy becomes more chaotic, she’ll eventually die! The treasure left behind by the Immortal Phoenix contains a wisp of her true yang soul. If she doesn’t fuse with it, she’ll die without her true yang.]

When Lin Fan heard this, his face sank.

“Dad, can I go look for that thing?” Lin Yulian asked.

Lin Fan was silent.

Qiu Ziqian walked over from afar.

Looking at Lin Fan’s silent expression, she understood immediately.

She said, “Lin Fan, it’s not convenient for you to leave Earth. Let Yulian and I go search for it.”

For the past year, Qiu Ziqian had seen her daughter suffering from nightmares every day. She was anxious.

Lin Fan thought for a moment and said, “You guys should take ownership of these things and use your souls to contact me.”

He really could not leave Earth.

This was because Earth was like a huge treasure trove.

Once he left, it would be extremely dangerous if a powerful enemy attacked.

After saying that, Lin Fan handed over the Rainbow Immortal Robe, True Qilin Armor, and Myriad Dawn Boots.

The Rainbow Immortal Robe and the True Qilin Armor could both block attacks below the Emperor level.

As for the Myriad Dawn Boots, they could allow the wearer’s speed to reach the Emperor level.

With these three treasures, they should be enough to ensure their safety.

Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian sensed the mysterious aura from the three treasures and knew that they were extraordinary treasures.

They did not decline.

This was because they knew that they might encounter some danger this time.

If something happened to them, Lin Fan would be very sad.

The next day, after everyone in the Coiling Dragon Villa gathered for a sumptuous lunch, Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian soared into the sky and instantly turned into light spots, flying straight into the vast universe.

Right now, Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian had already reached the Star Traveller level. Traveling in space was not a difficult thing for them.

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Su Ningjing, Lin Xiaoyao, and the others originally wanted to go with Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian.

However, Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian politely rejected him.

This was because they did not know how long they would be gone for. In addition, they did not want to bring more people into danger.

Therefore, at this moment, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Su Ningjing, Lin Xiaoyao, and the others could only quietly watch Qiu Ziqian’s and Lin Yulian’s departing figures from the Coiling Dragon Villa. At the same time, they silently prayed for them in their hearts.

Five years passed in a flash.

In the past five years, Lin Fan had focused even more on cultivation.

He wanted to have stronger power as soon as possible so that he could better protect his family and the earth.

Just like five years ago…

In Lin Fan’s opinion, if he had enough strength, he could teleport to where the Immortal Phoenix was hiding. Why would he need Qiu Ziqian and Lin Yulian to risk their lives in the universe?

Just like decades ago…

If Lin Fan had enough power, he could easily bring Lin Chengzhen back.

On this day…

A gust of wind suddenly appeared on the originally peaceful Earth, causing all the trees to sway left and right. The clothes of countless people rustled.

In the next moment…

In the east, a golden light that was like the sun continued to rise and spread, enveloping the entire sky and the entire world in golden light.

In the next moment, a boundless aura that made people want to kneel and worship spread across the entire Earth.

Lin Fan, who was at the center of the golden light, let out a muffled groan.

“Breakthrough!”
